title: Room 214
summary: The night before an away game your room-mate climbs out of the window at eleven to meet someone. He asks you to cover if the gaffer knocks. The gaffer knocks. A season on, the same hotel.

ends.title: Covered
ends.text: You covered for your room-mate the night he went out of the hotel window. The gaffer knew. Your room-mate owes you, and reminds you of it.

ends.title: The knock
ends.text: You didn't cover for your room-mate when the gaffer knocked. He was fined. He asked for a different room-mate.

event.title: The window
event.speaker: roomie
setup: Room 214, eleven o'clock, the night before an away game. {roomie.name} has his good shirt on and one leg out of the window. It's the first floor.

say: "One hour. Someone I knew at school lives round the corner. If he knocks, I'm in the shower. Please."

replies.label: "Get back in. You'll get us both fined."

cover.text: At twenty past eleven the gaffer knocks. You say he's in the shower. You turn the shower on. The gaffer stands there listening to it for a long time, then goes.

no.text: He goes anyway. At twenty past eleven the gaffer knocks. You open the door and say nothing, and the open window says the rest.

beats.title: The same hotel

event.title: The same hotel
event.speaker: roomie
setup: A season on, the same hotel. The rooming list is on the board in reception. {manager.short} is standing next to it with his arms folded.

outcomes.text: You and {roomie.short}, room 214 again. Next to it the gaffer has written, in pen: "Window's been screwed shut."
{roomie.short} is rooming with the goalkeeper. He doesn't look at you in reception.
"Same room. I had the shower checked. It's a very loud shower." He knows. He's always known.
"Your room-mate asked for a change. Can't think why."
